# AgentConfig resource configuration reference

@include 'alerts/enterprise-alert.mdx'

This topic provides reference information for the `AgentConfig` custom resource. An `AgentConfig` defines the cluster-wide defaults for the AI agent sidecar that Consul injects into pods annotated with `consul.hashicorp.com/ai-role: ai-agent`. The sidecar handles interceptor proxying, MCP connectivity, and optional human-in-the-loop (HITL) approval.

Refer to [Kubernetes annotations and labels](/consul/docs/reference/k8s/annotation-label) for the pod annotations that override these defaults.

## Configuration model

The following list outlines the field hierarchy, data types, and requirements for the `AgentConfig` resource. Click a property name to view additional details, including default values.

- [`apiVersion`](#apiversion): string | required | must be set to `consul.hashicorp.com/v1alpha1`
- [`kind`](#kind): string | required | must be set to `AgentConfig`
- [`metadata`](#metadata): map | required
   - [`name`](#metadata-name): string | required
- [`spec`](#spec): map | required
   - [`enabled`](#spec-enabled): boolean | required | `false`
   - [`defaults`](#spec-defaults): map
      - [`interceptorPort`](#spec-defaults-interceptorport): integer | `21101`
      - [`mcpPort`](#spec-defaults-mcpport): integer | `15101`
      - [`hitl`](#spec-defaults-hitl): map
         - [`port`](#spec-defaults-hitl-port): integer | `16101`
         - [`approvalTimeout`](#spec-defaults-hitl-approvaltimeout): string | `60s`
      - [`resources`](#spec-defaults-resources): map
         - [`requests`](#spec-defaults-resources-requests): map
         - [`limits`](#spec-defaults-resources-limits): map

## Complete configuration

When every field is defined, an `AgentConfig` resource has the following form:

```yaml
apiVersion: consul.hashicorp.com/v1alpha1
kind: AgentConfig
metadata:
  name: <name for this resource>
spec:
  enabled: <boolean>
  defaults:
    interceptorPort: <integer>
    mcpPort: <integer>
    hitl:
      port: <integer>
      approvalTimeout: <string>
    resources:
      requests: <map>
      limits: <map>
```

## Specification

This section describes the fields you can configure in the `AgentConfig` resource.

### `apiVersion`

Specifies the API version of the resource.

#### Values

- Default: None
- This field is required.
- Data type: String value that must be set to `consul.hashicorp.com/v1alpha1`.

### `kind`

Specifies the type of resource.

#### Values

- Default: None
- This field is required.
- Data type: String value that must be set to `AgentConfig`.

### `metadata`

Map that contains the name for the resource. This resource is cluster scoped.

#### Values

- Default: None
- This field is required.
- Data type: Map

### `metadata.name`

Specifies the name of the resource.

#### Values

- Default: None
- This field is required.
- Data type: String

### `spec`

Spec defines the desired state of AgentConfig.

#### Values

- Default: None
- This field is required.
- Data type: Map

### `spec.enabled`

Enabled controls whether the AI agent sidecar feature is active. When false the controller takes no action on annotated pods.

#### Values

- Default: `false`
- This field is required.
- Data type: Boolean

### `spec.defaults`

Defaults contains the cluster-wide default settings applied to every agent-annotated pod unless overridden at the pod annotation level.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `spec.defaults.interceptorPort`

TCP port the agent interceptor listens on inside the pod. Must not conflict with the application or Envoy proxy port (20000).

#### Values

- Default: `21101`
- Data type: Integer
- Minimum: `1024`
- Maximum: `65535`

### `spec.defaults.mcpPort`

TCP port used for MCP connectivity within the pod.

#### Values

- Default: `15101`
- Data type: Integer
- Minimum: `1024`
- Maximum: `65535`

### `spec.defaults.hitl`

HITL contains human-in-the-loop approval settings for the agent.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `spec.defaults.hitl.port`

TCP port the HITL approval server listens on inside the pod.

#### Values

- Default: `16101`
- Data type: Integer
- Minimum: `1024`
- Maximum: `65535`

### `spec.defaults.hitl.approvalTimeout`

Duration the agent waits for a human approval before timing out.

#### Values

- Default: `60s`
- Data type: String

### `spec.defaults.resources`

Resources defines the CPU/memory requests and limits for the agent init-container injected into each annotated pod.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `spec.defaults.resources.requests`

Requests describes the minimum amount of compute resources required.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map

### `spec.defaults.resources.limits`

Limits describes the maximum amount of compute resources allowed.

#### Values

- Default: None
- Data type: Map
